entries.1497143e151fb4c0: This business publishes and sells books and magazines covering general corporate management and other fields. The consolidated subsidiary Chuokeizai-sha Co., Ltd. handles planning and editing of books and magazines, Shiootsu Co., Ltd. handles editing and production of magazines, books and mooks, and Chuokeizai Group Publishing Co., Ltd. handles production and sales.

entries.685fcb65919758dd: Faculty and students at universities and junior colleges
entries.8951e90da13f1115: Companies that commission the production of product catalogs and sales promotion pamphlets
entries.a5eac9a1690f583c: The company publishes four magazines: “Kigyō Kaikei,” which covers accounting theory and research on and explanation of accounting standards; “Zeimu Kōhō,” which provides correct legal interpretations and processing guidelines for tax practice; “Junkan Keiri Jōhō,” which provides news and commentary on accounting, taxation, finance, securities and legal affairs; and “Business Hōmu,” which explains corporate legal practice and provides examination information for the Business Law Examination. The exam preparation magazine for certified public accountants, certified tax accountants and bookkeeping, “Kaikeijin Course,” has moved to its electronic edition, “Kaikeijin Course Web.”
entries.c2a617cf4d918163: Book distributors such as Nippon Shuppan Hanbai Inc. and Tohan Corporation
entries.cf91b478741a7c20: The holding company of the Chuokeizai-sha Group, which publishes and sells specialized books and magazines on management, economics, law, accounting, taxation and information.
entries.dcfedb01b3345722: The company publishes a wide range of books, including academic research books in the fields of management, economics, law, accounting, taxation and information; specialized practical books on business management issues; business how-to books; textbooks for universities and junior colleges; study books for various qualification and certification examinations; and practical books on IT. It also publishes legal compilations such as “Kaikei Zensho,” “Kaikei Hōkishū” and “Kansa Shōroppō.”
entries.e4049375c9ecadd9: This business is conducted by consolidated subsidiary Planning Center Co., Ltd., which acts as contracted agent for advertising for media mainly in the taxation, accounting and legal fields. It also acts as contracted agent for advertisements placed in magazines published by the company group, and plans and produces product catalogs and sales promotion pamphlets for companies.
